list.snippet: Address: Adi Shankaracharya Marg, Powai, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400076
Setting: A 545-acre green campus situated between Powai Lake and Vihar Lake.
Proximity: Roughly 15 kilometers (9 miles) away from Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport.
Nearest Railway Stations: Kanjurmarg and Vikhroli on the Central Railway line.
Local Transit: Accessible via local suburban trains, buses, auto rickshaws, and taxis from various parts of Mumbai.

🌱 IIT Bombay marked the opening of Green Cup 2026–27, the Institute's flagship Inter-Hostel Sustainability Championship, reinforcing its commitment to a clean, green, and happy campus. Green Cup runs throughout the year, turning hostels into active participants in campus sustainability by scoring them on how they manage energy, water and waste. For 2026–27, the general championship adds a new individual participation track to inculcate sustainability values among all students conducting case competitions, debates and workshops, and is supported by a growing network of Sustainability Champions across hostels. The ceremony was graced by the Director Prof. Shireesh Kedare along with Dean (Student Affairs) Prof. Kowsik Bodi, Associate Dean (Student Affairs) Prof. Himanshu Bahirat, Associate Dean (Student Affairs) Prof. Deepak Marla, Dean (IPS) Prof. P. Vedagiri, Associate Dean (IPS, EMA) Prof. Neeraj Kumbhakarna, Associate Dean (IPS, EHS) Prof. Prakash Nanthagopalan, and other Institut

IIT Bombay congratulates Mr. Aditya B. Mundhe of the Estate Office and Mr. Mansingh B. Mehra of the Electrical Maintenance Division on receiving the Outstanding Young Engineer Award 2024–25 under the Best Zonal Work Award category. Conferred at the Institute’s National Engineers’ Day 2026 celebration, the award recognises their outstanding contributions to the development of campus infrastructure. #NationalEngineersDay #IITBombay #CampusInfrastructure

Congratulations to Prof. Arnab Dutta of IIT Bombay’s Department of Chemistry and Prof. Vikram Vishal of the Department of Earth Sciences on receiving the Dr. P.K. Patwardhan Technology Development Award 2025. Conferred during the Institute’s National Engineers’ Day celebration, the award recognises their innovative research and development work on “Integrated CO₂ Capture and Conversion Technology”. #NationalEngineersDay #IITBombay #TechnologyDevelopment

Congratulations to Prof. Joel Yang on receiving the IIT Bombay International Award for Excellence in Research in Engineering and Technology during IIT Bombay’s National Engineers’ Day 2026 celebration. Prof. Yang is Professor and Associate Head of Pillar for Research (Engineering Product Development), Director (Cleanroom), OPTICA Fellow, and Cheng Tsang Man Chair Professor at the Singapore University of Technology and Design. Instituted by Mr. Sandeep Naik and Mr. Shantanu Rastogi, the award recognises impactful contributions to engineering and technology research over the past decade. #NationalEngineersDay #IITBombay #EngineeringResearch

During the National Engineers’ Day 2026, the Chief Guest Mr. S.N. Subrahmanyan, Chairman and Managing Director, Larsen & Toubro Limited, in his address said, “The world is full of tremendous opportunities — in energy transition, digital transformation, artificial intelligence, robotics and localisation. The opportunities before young engineers today are truly exciting. Research, technology, application, scale and impact will increasingly shape the future. Knowledge gives capability, character gives credibility, and execution creates impact. Encourage young engineers to seize these opportunities, build enterprises, harness technology to solve real problems, and contribute meaningfully to the nation”. @larsentoubro

IT Bombay celebrated National Engineers’ Day 2026 by paying tribute to Bharat Ratna Sir M. Visvesvaraya and honouring achievements in research, technology development and campus infrastructure. We were honoured to have Mr. S.N. Subrahmanyan, Chairman and Managing Director, Larsen & Toubro Limited, as the Chief Guest. During the programme, the Institute conferred the: * IIT Bombay International Award for Excellence in Research in Engineering and Technology * Dr. P.K. Patwardhan Technology Development Award 2025 * C1973 Faculty Awards for Research Excellence * Prof. S.L. Mehndiratta Award 2026 and awards under the Best Zonal Work Award category @larsentoubro #NationalEngineersDay #IITBombay #EngineeringExcellence
